about: Decided 2-fer pairs and fixed links that used to be written inside kpc_fers.py (KNOWN_LIVE, KY_DROP, SAME_LAND_PAIRS, MAPFIX), moved here unchanged (Handoff 9, bug 8, 2026-11-17), plus the world layer kinds that are designation lines (bug 6). One entry per ruling, each with the date and who ruled. kpc_fers.py reads this file at start and stops loudly if it is missing or broken. A change here changes the 2-fer rules hash (kpc_key_freeze 'fers'), so it is rechecked like a code change.

world_designation_layers.why: UK national parks, national landscapes (AONB), national scenic areas and regional parks are lines drawn by law around mostly private land: a pair of two of them gets the 'May contain private land' approximate note, as US designation lines do (Q1)
world_designation_layers.ruled_by: KPC owner Q1 ruling (2026-11-17 11:14 AM) applied to the world (Handoff 9, bug 6)
